title: Optimus-Vibe game definition
description: config/games/<id>.yaml. Mirrors GameDef in src/OptimusVibe.Core/Config/Models.cs (camelCase). Unknown top-level keys are rejected by the loader, so they are rejected here too.

id.description: Game id; must equal the file name without .yaml (used on the command line: `optimus-vibe run <id>`).

store.description: Where the game comes from (the validator accepts steam, battlenet, ea, other; use other + storeIds for Epic/GOG/Xbox until it accepts those). Affects launch notes and `shortcut`.

steamAppId.description: Steam app id (also usable in {SteamLibrary:<appid>} path tokens).

storeIds.description: Ids in other launchers, used to match auto-detected installs to this config (Steam uses steamAppId). battlenet: product code (e.g. Fen); ea: offer id; epic: AppName; gog: game id; xbox: package family name.

battlenet.description: Battle.net product code, e.g. Pro (Overwatch), Fen (Diablo IV).

epic.description: Epic Games Store AppName (from the launcher manifest).

gog.description: GOG game id (numeric, as a string).

xbox.description: Xbox app / Microsoft Store package family name (e.g. Publisher.Game_8wekyb3d8bbwe).

cloudSyncsSettings.description: Whether the game's graphics settings travel between machines (Steam Cloud / store cloud). false = each machine keeps its own settings, so the app suggests opting the game out of management. null or omitted = unknown. Filled in by the game-settings-recommender skill.

processes.description: Process names (e.g. Game.exe) the `run` wrapper waits on; launcher stubs often exit early.

files.description: Settings stores this game uses. Presets and profiles refer to them by id.

profiles.description: Shared building blocks (usually just `base`) that presets `extends`. Never applied directly and not named after devices.

presets.description: Claude-recommended presets: device id (from devices.yaml) -> preset name -> body. Conventional names: desktop: quality, performance; ally-x: performance, battery; every device: big-picture (picked automatically on a 4K TV, see devices.yaml bigPicture).

intent.description: Free-text intent per device, written by the user; Claude reads it when mapping settings.

recommendation.description: When and how the recommended presets were generated (written by the game-settings-recommender skill).

gameVersion.description: Game version/patch the keys were checked against, if known.

sources.description: Where key names and value choices came from (URLs, `inspect` runs).

notes.description: Free-text notes (quirks, Steam Cloud, unverified keys...).

launch.description: How to start the game when it is not wrapped by Steam's %command% (Battle.net/EA/shortcut). Give a uri or an exe.

exe.description: Executable path (path tokens allowed), e.g. Battle.net.exe

id.description: Key used in presets/profiles. Must not be a reserved key.

handler.description: ini: nested by [section]. json: dotted paths with [n] and [field=value] filters. xml: XPath. registry: value names under a key. keyvalue: one setting per line (format/template). file: whole-file snapshot only, no keys.

path.description: File path with tokens {Documents} {LocalAppData} {AppData} {LocalLow} {SavedGames} {UserProfile} {ProgramData} {ProgramFiles} {ProgramFilesX86} {SteamRoot} {SteamLibrary:<appid>} {SteamUserData:<appid>}, %ENV% vars and * wildcards (newest match wins). For handler registry: HKCU\... or HKLM\...

format.description: keyvalue only. cvar: SET key "value"; quoted: key "value"; equals: key=value (default); equals-spaced: key = value; colon: key: value

template.description: keyvalue only: custom line template containing {key} and {value}; wins over format.

readOnlyAfterApply.description: Mark the file read-only after applying (games that reset settings on boot).

createIfMissing.description: Create the file if absent (otherwise it is skipped with a warning).

scalar.description: A setting value. null removes the key inherited from an extended profile.

settingsBlock.description: Settings for one file id. ini: { "Section": { Key: value } } (top-level scalars are keys before the first section). json: nested maps are joined with '.', or use full paths as keys. xml: XPath keys. registry: value names. keyvalue: keys.

display.description: inherit (or device): use the device's display from devices.yaml. none (or keep): leave the display alone (also the default when display is omitted). A map overrides parts of the device mode.

driverBlock.description: Driver setting name -> value. A nested map is flattened to "k=v,k=v".

profile.description: Shared base. Reserved keys: extends, display, nvidia, amd. Every other key must be a file id from `files`.

extends.description: Name of another entry under `profiles:` to inherit from (deep merge; this one wins).

nvidia.description: NVIDIA driver (DRS) per-exe profile settings. Ignored unless the device driver is nvidia. Persistent; not undone on exit.

amd.description: AMD ADLX global 3D settings, applied on launch and restored on exit. Ignored unless the device driver is amd. Not implemented yet (see docs/amd-adlx.md).

preset.description: A recommended preset. Reserved keys: label, description, targetFps, extends, display, nvidia, amd. Every other key must be a file id from `files`.

label.description: Name shown in the app (default: the preset name, capitalized).

description.description: 1-2 sentences: what the preset targets and what it trades away.

targetFps.description: Framerate the preset aims for (informational, shown in the app).

extends.description: Name of an entry under `profiles:` (presets cannot extend presets).

nvidia.description: NVIDIA driver (DRS) per-exe profile settings. Ignored unless the device driver is nvidia. Persistent; not undone on exit.

amd.description: AMD ADLX global 3D settings, applied on launch and restored on exit. Ignored unless the device driver is amd. Not implemented yet (see docs/amd-adlx.md).
